project.description: Name of the project, or a folder to migrate (e.g. ./libs). Without it the whole workspace is migrated

fix.description: Whether overwrite icons prefixes or simply inform in console

stylesExt.description: Use this option to specify styles extension preferred in your project

customDataPath.description: JSON file with the icon mapping, an array of { "replace": "kbq-<old>", "replaceWith": "kbq-<new>" }, relative to the workspace root. Without it the built-in mapping is used

customIconReplacementPath.description: JSON file with the scope pair, [{ "replace": "mc", "replaceWith": "kbq" }], relative to the workspace root. Without it the scope is mc -> kbq
